title: New Wave Wonders
theme: Disney's modern animated features of the 2010s and 2020s, from Tangled and Frozen to Encanto, Moana, Zootopia and Wish
intro: [excited] Hold onto your snowflakes! Tonight is NEW WAVE WONDERS, all about Disney animation from the 2010s and 2020s. [laughs] Ice palaces, magic houses, rabbit cops and wishing stars. If you have a little sibling, they might crush you in this one.

art.prompt: Wide 16:9 title card: a glowing modern fantasy skyline at twilight where a frosty ice palace, a colorful Colombian-style hillside house with glowing windows, an island volcano and a futuristic fusion city sit side by side under a sky full of sparkling wishing stars, vibrant CG-animation style No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: Miracle Madrigals
categories.intro: [excited] Our film category is 2021's Encanto! [whispers] Yes, we are going to talk about Bruno.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a magical colorful casita in the Colombian mountains glowing from within, its shutters and roof tiles rippling as if alive, golden butterflies and a single glowing candle in the window No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: The only Madrigal kid in Encanto who did not receive a magical gift.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mirabel! [excited] No gift, and yet she saves the whole family. Glasses girls, unite.

clues.clue: Tio Bruno's magical gift.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is seeing the future. [whispers] We don't talk about Bruno... no, no, no. [laughs] Except right now.

clues.clue: Luisa, the eldest sister who sings Surface Pressure, has this gift.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is super strength! [chuckles] She can move a church, a donkey, and a river. Just give her a nap.

clues.clue: Encanto is set in this South American country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Colombia! [excited] And it's spelled with two O's, folks. The music is full of Colombian rhythms.

clues.clue: The name of Abuela Alma's late husband, whose sacrifice created the miracle.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Pedro. His candle became the miracle that built the casita. Pass the tissues, please.

categories.title: New Kids on the Block
categories.intro: [excited] This themed category is all about the newer stars of Disney animation. Chickens, bunnies, sloths and kings!

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a sunny brand-new storybook neighborhood street where every house is a different fantasy style: a tropical hut, a fox-sized city apartment, a sparkling wish-shaped tower, bright confetti in the air No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: In Moana, this silly rooster stows away on the canoe.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Heihei! [laughs] He tried to eat a rock. Several times. Bless him.

clues.clue: In Zootopia, police officer Judy Hopps is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a rabbit! [chuckles] Only a bunny can call another bunny cute. Everyone else, watch it.

clues.clue: The super-slow sloth who works at the Zootopia DMV.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... [dramatic pause] Flash. [laughs] Took me that long to say it. Very on brand.

clues.clue: In 2023's Wish, Asha's wish summons this glowing little friend from the sky.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Star! [excited] Wish came out for Disney's 100th birthday, and that little ball of light stole the show.

clues.clue: The sorcerer king who keeps everyone's wishes locked away in the kingdom of Rosas.
clues.reveal: [mischievously] The correct answer is King Magnifico! Voiced by Chris Pine, and his villain song is called This Is the Thanks I Get. Rude!

categories.title: Modern Masterpieces
categories.intro: [excited] It's PICTURE time! Each scene comes from a modern Disney animated film. No characters, just clues. Name the movie.

clues.clue: Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen! [laughs] A glittering ice palace on a mountaintop. Somebody just let it go.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zootopia! [excited] A frozen tundra right next to a steamy rainforest. Anyone can be anything... except warm in Tundratown.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! [excited] A canoe, a glowing green spiral stone, and the open ocean. How far will you go?

categories.title: Fresh Magic in the Parks
categories.intro: [excited] Our parks category puts modern Disney films on the map, from Epcot to Tokyo. Passports out!

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a frosty Scandinavian village with grass-roofed buildings beside a turquoise water trail winding through tropical rocks, and far away a fairy-tale lantern-lit forest springs, bright travel-poster style No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: The Epcot boat ride where you sail through Arendelle with Anna and Elsa.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen Ever After! [laughs] Watch out for that backwards drop. Olaf did warn you.

clues.clue: Frozen Ever After sits in this World Showcase pavilion at Epcot.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Norway! [chuckles] It replaced a Viking boat ride called Maelstrom in 2016. Vikings out, snowmen in.

clues.clue: This walk-through Epcot attraction, which opened in 2023, lets you play with living water.
clues.answer: Journey of Water, Inspired by Moana
accept: journey of water inspired by moana
choices: Journey of Water, Inspired by Moana
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Journey of Water, Inspired by Moana! [excited] The water wiggles, splashes and plays hide and seek. Bring a towel.

clues.clue: The very first World of Frozen land opened in 2023 at this Disney park.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Hong Kong Disneyland! A whole walkable Arendelle, with a ride and a coaster. Do you wanna build a vacation?

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea's Fantasy Springs, which opened in 2024, has areas themed to Frozen, Peter Pan and this 2010 film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tangled! [excited] Rapunzel's Forest, with lanterns of course. Tokyo DisneySea does NOT play around.

categories.title: Say That Again?
categories.intro: [chuckles] Our voice actor reads a famous line. You tell me which modern Disney character said it. [whispers] No peeking at the subtitles.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a vintage studio microphone in a recording booth with soundwave ribbons of color swirling out across a starry backdrop, a pair of headphones on a stool No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Which character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf! [sighs] Some people are worth melting for. A snowman with a heart of gold.
clues.quote: Some people are worth melting for.

clues.clue: Which character said this?
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Maui! Voiced by Dwayne Johnson. What can he say except... you're welcome?

clues.clue: Which character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Baymax! [chuckles] On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate your trivia skills?
clues.quote: Hello. I am Baymax, your personal healthcare companion.

clues.clue: Which character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wreck-It Ralph! [laughs] He's bad, and that's good. He'll never be good, and that's not bad.

clues.clue: Which character said this?
clues.reveal: [mischievously] The correct answer is Chief Bogo, the grumpy Cape buffalo from Zootopia. Yes, he really did slip a Frozen joke into a cop movie.
clues.quote: Life isn't some cartoon musical where you sing a little song and all your insipid dreams magically come true. So let it go.
